text:
lena: Quick note  ran the TypeScript Next starter (LangChain + Redwood SDK) and hit two small DX bumps: type errors in the sample agent and intermittent CI flakes on the eval harness matrix. Anyone else?
omar: Yep, saw the types. The example uses `agent.options` which is not on the exported Agent type in sdk-js@0.9. Patch in starter points at bad API.
kevin: I hit the CI flake. GH actions matrix (node 16/18/20) sometimes fails on node 16 with EADDRINUSE when the harness spawns a dev server twice. Locally fine.
lena: Minimal repro for types: open `examples/ts/pages/api/agent.ts` and try `agent.options.telemetry = {...}` -> tsc error `Property 'options' does not exist on type 'Agent'`.
omar: Quick fix in starter: cast to `any` or better update to use the stable helper `wrapAgentWithTelemetry(agent, ctx)` in utils. I'll open a PR to change the sample to the helper and update types with a small declaration file.
kevin: For CI flake: harness spins up server on port 3001 and the parallel test job sometimes still has old process. Proposed fix: randomize port via env TEST_PORT or use `get-port` + retry. I'll patch the GH action and add teardown to kill the server.
ci-bot: created issue #DE-523: "next-ts-starter: agent typing mismatch + eval harness port flake" assigned to @omar @kevin.
lena: Also note: the starter README suggests `yarn dev` in root, but monorepo scripts changed. I'll update README to show `cd examples/ts && pnpm dev` with node version note.
omar: PR #213: replace direct `agent.options` access with `wrapAgentWithTelemetry` helper and add `types/agent-augment.d.ts` to the example to keep it strict.
kevin: PR #214: GH action uses `get-port` and sets TEST_PORT, plus adds a process cleanup step in after_job. Added matrix for node 18/20 only (dropping 16) to reduce noise.
lena: Great. After merge, patch the quickstart generator so new templates use the fixed example. Also add a tiny CI smoke job that runs the eval harness once on merge.
ci-bot: marked DE-523 as needs-docs and needs-ci.
omar: Merged PR for types, adding a small note in the code comment about future SDK parity changes.
kevin: Merged CI fix; rerun shows green on matrix.
lena: Thanks all. Updating onboarding checklist to mention running `pnpm --filter examples/ts dev` and linking the issue for token rotation if folks hit auth problems.
